Days were spent working tirelessly toward 
the promotional live. Light Hello handled 
the chores and prep work, eagerly 
providing her support throughout.

However, at the pop-up live concert she 
held, not a single person stopped to 
watch. Light Hello felt disheartened, 
blaming her own lack of ability.

Smart Falcon was pumped to capture 
everyone's hearts next, but Light Hello 
seemed somehow dispirited—

Inviting her to a cafe to talk, she 
confessed that since she had little live 
performance experience, she didn't really 
know what would make one a success.

The next day, Agnes Tachyon shows interest 
in their activities after seeing a flyer. 
She announces that she will come to the 
live show with one other person in tow.
